title: R Data Visualization Workshop
text:
📊
    
    R Data Visualization Workshop
    
      A comprehensive, tiered learning platform for data wrangling,
      statistical analysis, and visualization in R
    
    
      Dr. Mukul Maheshwari  ·  Dr. Rudresh Negi
      Department of Community Medicine
    
  





  Choose Your Workshop Track
  
    Select the track that matches your level. Basic is open to everyone.
    Other tracks require a workshop key provided by the session organiser.
